tier.doc: Maximum tier of blocks this drill can mine.

drillTime.doc: Base time to drill one ore, in frames.

liquidBoostIntensity.doc: How many times faster the drill will progress when boosted by liquid.

warmupSpeed.doc: Speed at which the drill speeds up.

blockedItem.doc: Special exemption item that this drill can't mine.

blockedItems.doc: Special exemption items that this drill can't mine.

drawMineItem.doc: Whether to draw the item this drill is mining.

drillEffect.doc: Effect played when an item is produced. This is colored.

drillEffectRnd.doc: Drill effect randomness. Block size by default.

drillEffectChance.doc: Chance of displaying the effect. Useful for extremely fast drills.

rotateSpeed.doc: Speed the drill bit rotates at.

updateEffectChance.doc: Chance the update effect will appear.

drillMultipliers.doc: Multipliers of drill speed for each item. Defaults to 1.
